# 🛡️ Support

## 💬 How to Get Help

### 📖 Read the Documentation
Before asking for help, please read:
- [📖 README](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/blob/main/README.md) — features, setup, troubleshooting
- [📁 docs/](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/tree/main/docs) — permissions, data sources, third-party licenses

### 🔍 Search Existing Issues
Your question may have already been answered. Search:
- [🐛 Open Issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/issues)
- [✅ Closed Issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed)

### 💬 GitHub Discussions
For questions, ideas, and community help:
- [🤝 GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/discussions)

### 🐛 Report a Bug
If you've found a bug in NexKey, please open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/issues/new?template=01-bug-report.yml).

### ✨ Request a Feature
Have an idea for NexKey? Open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/issues/new?template=02-feature-request.yml).

## 📝 What GitHub Issues Is For

GitHub Issues is for **bug reports and feature requests only**.

## 🚫 What GitHub Issues Is NOT For

- ❓ **General help questions** — use [Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/discussions)
- 🔧 **Setup problems** — check the [Troubleshooting section](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/blob/main/README.md#troubleshooting)
- 🎨 **Customizing themes** — check the in-app Theme settings
- ✨ **Feature requests** — use the [Feature Request](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexKey-Keyboard/issues/new?template=02-feature-request.yml) template
